parameters.name: ByObSessionId
parameters.description: Indicates whether to perform the KILL operation based on the specified database connection ID. The default value is false, which means the KILL operation is performed based on the proxy link ID to terminate all corresponding database connections.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the OceanBase cluster.

parameters.name: SessionList
parameters.description: The list of sessions to close.
